div.div: Illustration of the reparameterization trick. The variational parameters ϕ affect the objective f through the random variable z ~ qϕ(z|x). We wish to compute gradients ∇ϕf to optimize the objective with SGD. In the original form (left), we cannot differentiate f w.r.t. ϕ, because we cannot directly backpropagate gradients through the random variable z. We can 'externalize' the randomness in z by re-parameterizing the variable as a deterministic and differentiable function of ϕ, x, and a newly introduced random variable ε. This allows us to 'backprop through z', and compute gradients ∇ϕf.
